00 · Mental model

One equation, seven modules: click any part

How to read it

The equation at the top is one SGD step. Each coloured term is computed by one module, and the map below shows the same loop as data moving between modules around the Tensor + Autograd core. Click a box, a chip or a term to open its panel; click empty space to return to the overview.

Why this grouping

It groups modules by the role they play in the step rather than by kind: Layers and Activations together are the model f; Losses close the graph; Autograd differentiates it; the Optimizer is the only module that sits outside the graph and changes θ.
